SELECT contract_json,contract_digest,target_digest FROM service_task_contract WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_key=#{key} AND operation_version=#{version}

SELECT operation_key,MAX(operation_version) AS latest_version FROM service_task_contract WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_key>#{afterKey} GROUP BY operation_key ORDER BY operation_key LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT operation_version FROM service_task_contract WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND operation_key=#{argument2} AND operation_version<#{argument3} ORDER BY operation_version DESC LIMIT #{argument4}
